testName: EDA: Student Course Connection Registration & Prerequisite Validation
steps:
1. Open Student Contact "Michael Zhang"
2. In Course Connections related list, click "New Course Connection"
3. Select Course Offering "CS-301: Advanced Algorithms (Fall 2026)"
4. In Record Type, select "Student"
5. Enter Enrollment Status "Enrolled"
6. Click on Save button
7. Verify EDA automated prerequisite trigger validates that student previously completed "CS-201: Data Structures"
8. Verify Course Offering current enrollment count increments from 24 to 25
9. Verify Term Grade record is initialized in "In Progress" status
